title: hat/coat hanger
text: hat/coat hanger. I bought this primarily to hang xmas stockings on come the season, but it is honestly cool as just a stand alone piece!  It took me about 10 minutes to put together, alone.  One screw uses an allen wrench which they provide.  The tips are wood, darker - walnut like for sure although I can't tell exactly what wood is used for sure.  The stand itself is metal and painted a flat black, very well represented in the photos.  It's height is over 5'8" (my height) and the base is weighted, which is really nice. Holds it in place securely where ever you set it, floor or carpet.  It fits into the theme of my house nicely.  It arrived quickly (I have prime) and in great condition.  It is actually a very sturdy piece.  It feels like it will last for many seasons.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info be useful and always respond to questions/comments.  Further, I do NOT receive compensation of ANY kind for my reviews.  This is a VERIFIED purchase, full price, unsolicited, independent purchase, so you can trust that my reviews are honest and complete.
